integrity: The only recent imported premise is the pointwise regularized Hessian estimate in Proposition 2.2 of arXiv:2609.37504v1. The radial integration, infinite-dimensional compression passage, strict comparison with the frozen-radius theorem, and rank-one equality calculation were reconstructed independently. The normalization was checked against the classical Poisson--Jensen formula and against the published frozen-radius coefficient. No numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a lower bound for circular means along one complex affine line. It does not provide a converse, an upper bound, an embedding classification, or an optimal finite-dimensional distortion theorem. Sharpness is established by rank-one rays from the origin, not by a classification of all equality cases. An older equivalent formulation under Riesz-measure or PL-convexity terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: A sharp radial Riesz-kernel refinement of the Schatten circular-mean inequality
